tests.name: PlatformSettingCatalogExamGraceTest
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-01: setting exam_answer_grace_seconds catalogued, default "120", unit "seconds", editable, minimum >= 0

tests.name: BillingSettingsServiceExamGraceTest (4)
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-01: examAnswerGraceSeconds(int fallback) returns stored value (0 allowed); missing/invalid -> fallback

tests.name: AttemptDeadlinePolicyTest (6)
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-01: deadline = examEndTime + grace(setting); null examEndTime -> no deadline; exactly at deadline allowed, +1s past

tests.name: AttemptSaveDeadlineGuardTest (5)
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-01: save past deadline -> AttemptDeadlinePassedException 409 ATTEMPT_DEADLINE_PASSED and publishes AttemptLateSyncRejectedEvent

tests.name: AttemptLifecycleServiceDeadlineTest (3)
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-01: saveAnswer and submitAnswer one hour past examEndTime -> 409 ATTEMPT_DEADLINE_PASSED, nothing persisted; submitAttempt past deadline still SUBMITS (guard, passes today)
tests.red_reason: 2 failing (no deadline check), submit guard passes today

tests.name: AttemptAutoSubmitterTest (6)
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-01 sweeper step: submit overdue IN_PROGRESS once; skip if saved within grace window, not overdue, already SUBMITTED (idempotent), CREATED

tests.name: AttemptDeadlineSweeperTest (3)
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-01 sweeper: queries findInProgressIdsWithExamEndBefore(now - grace), counts submitted, one failure does not stop others

tests.name: LateSyncIncidentListenerTest (2)
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-01/H1: one LATE_SYNC_REJECTED incident per attempt (REPORTED, WARNING, NEW, clientEventId LATE_SYNC_REJECTED, dedup via findByAttemptPublicIdAndClientEventId)

tests.name: ScoringReviewReadQueryServiceObjectiveNotScoredTest (3)
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-03/H4: unscored OBJECTIVE row -> publishable=false, reason OBJECTIVE_NOT_SCORED; scored (incl. 0) and UNSCORED-method rows never block
tests.red_reason: 1 failing (objective currently never blocks), 2 guards pass

tests.name: ScoringIngestServiceBlankObjectiveTest (2)
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-03/H4: blank/null/whitespace objective payload is scored 0 at ingest even if the scorer throws, so it never becomes OBJECTIVE_NOT_SCORED; non-blank unscorable stays PENDING
tests.red_reason: 1 failing (blank objective left PENDING), 1 guard passes

tests.name: ReportPublishServiceObjectiveBlockerTest (4)
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-03: blocker lists attempt/answer/section/taskType/reason and rejects publish (guards); attempts whose report is already published (findByAttemptPublicId published + snapshot) do not count
tests.red_reason: 2 failing (published attempts still blocked), 2 guards pass

tests.name: SessionClassSourceServiceReassignTest (2)
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-15: ExamSession has no publishedAt and ClassStudent has no joinedAt, so re-assigning a class that is already an audience source of a SCHEDULED exam -> DomainException 409 CLASS_ALREADY_ASSIGNED, no enrol, no save; first assign unchanged
tests.red_reason: re-assign currently enrols new members (no throw)

tests.name: SessionClosedAttemptSubmitterNotStartedTest (2)
tests.acceptance_criterion: RF-18: CREATED attempts at session close are kept, status stays CREATED, not submitted/deleted, marked gradingExcluded=true reason NOT_STARTED, saved via saveAll(findBySessionPublicIdAndTenantIdAndStatus(..., CREATED))

tests.name: server_clock_test.dart (7)
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-02: ServerClock(wallClock, monotonicElapsed).syncWith(serverTime) sets offset; now() advances by monotonic only; wall clock back/forward ignored; resync replaces anchor; unsynced = wall clock

tests.name: timer_service_server_clock_test.dart (8)
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-02: TimerService(serverClock:) computes examRemaining/remaining/phase-transition from ServerClock.now(); device skew and mid-exam clock jumps neither extend nor cut time

tests.name: lockdown_service_monotonic_debounce_test.dart (5)
tests.acceptance_criterion: FR-02: LockdownService(monotonicElapsed:) debounces per type on the injected monotonic clock (1 s window, exactly 1 s is reported); wall clock never consulted so a backwards jump cannot drop events

expected_new_symbols: Platform setting exam_answer_grace_seconds: catalog entry (default 120, unit seconds, editable, min>=0) + seed row in new Flyway migration (V63, next free after V62) ; BillingSettingsService.examAnswerGraceSeconds(int fallbackSeconds) catching PlatformSettingNotFoundException/InvalidException -> fallback; attempt fallback constant 120 in AttemptConstants

com.pte.attempt.internal.service.deadline (new subpackage): AttemptDeadlinePolicy(BillingSettingsService, Clock) with grace(), Optional<Instant> deadline(ExamAttempt), boolean isPastDeadline(ExamAttempt) (strictly after examEndTime+grace; null examEndTime -> no deadline). There is NO per-attempt extension field on ExamAttempt today, so examEndTime is the only source

AttemptSaveDeadlineGuard(AttemptDeadlinePolicy, ApplicationEventPublisher, Clock).requireWithinDeadline(ExamAttempt) throws AttemptDeadlinePassedException (attempt.internal.exception, DomainException, HttpStatus.CONFLICT, code ATTEMPT_DEADLINE_PASSED constant in AttemptConstants) and publishes AttemptLateSyncRejectedEvent(attemptPublicId, sessionPublicId, tenantId, studentPublicId, Instant rejectedAt) (record in com.pte.attempt.dto.event). Wire into AttemptLifecycleService saveAnswer, saveEncryptedAnswer, submitAnswer, submitEncryptedAnswer (constructor of AttemptLifecycleService/AttemptAnswerRecorder changes: existing lifecycle tests need the new ctor arg, not weaker assertions). Never call it from submitAttempt. The exception rolls back the tx: record the incident in a REQUIRES_NEW listener (or noRollbackFor)

AttemptAnswerRepository: Optional<Instant> findLastSavedAt(Long attemptId) (max updatedAt of answers). ExamAttemptRepository: List<Long> findInProgressIdsWithExamEndBefore(Instant examEndBefore) (status IN_PROGRESS, deleted=false)

AttemptAutoSubmitter(ExamAttemptRepository, AttemptAnswerRepository, AttemptDeadlinePolicy, Clock).boolean autoSubmitIfOverdue(Long attemptId): @Transactional(REQUIRES_NEW), findWithLockById, return false unless IN_PROGRESS and past deadline and last save older than grace; else attempt.submit(clock.instant()) + save (AttemptSubmittedEvent fires, scoring ingest runs) -> true. Consider also taking the session lock like other attempt operations

AttemptDeadlineSweeper(ExamAttemptRepository, AttemptDeadlinePolicy, AttemptAutoSubmitter, Clock): @Scheduled sweepOnSchedule(); int sweepOverdueAttempts() querying findInProgressIdsWithExamEndBefore(now - grace), catching per-attempt RuntimeException

com.pte.proctoring.internal.listener.LateSyncIncidentListener(ExamIncidentRepository).onLateSyncRejected(AttemptLateSyncRejectedEvent): skip when findByAttemptPublicIdAndClientEventId(attempt, "LATE_SYNC_REJECTED") present; else save ExamIncident origin REPORTED, type/clientEventId LATE_SYNC_REJECTED, severity WARNING, status NEW, non-blank title, tenant/session/student/attempt from event, detectedAt = event.rejectedAt. Listener must run in its own transaction

scoring: ScoreReviewConstants.REASON_OBJECTIVE_NOT_SCORED = "OBJECTIVE_NOT_SCORED"; ScoringReviewReadQueryService.blockingReason returns it for ScoringMethod.OBJECTIVE rows not SCORED (UNSCORED/null method keep returning null); ScoringIngestService scores blank (null/blank) objective payloads 0 even when ObjectiveScoringService throws. Update old ScoringReviewReadQueryServiceTest.reportInputs_excludeUnscoredObjectiveWithoutBlockingPublication (contract change approved in plan validation)

reporting: ReportPublishService.readiness must ignore OBJECTIVE_NOT_SCORED blockers for attempts whose ExamResult is already published with a snapshot (examResultRepository.findByAttemptPublicId); other blockers unchanged. ReportPublicationBlockerResponse keeps (attemptPublicId, answerPublicId, section, taskType, reason); the student is resolved from attemptPublicId (add studentPublicId additively with a compatibility constructor if the UI needs it)

FR-15 decision: neither ClassStudent.joinedAt nor ExamSession.publishedAt exists, so SessionClassSourceService.assign on a SCHEDULED session whose class is already a CLASS source throws 409 CLASS_ALREADY_ASSIGNED (new exception + SessionConstants code); first assign and DRAFT behaviour unchanged. Remove/rewrite SessionClassSourceServiceTest.assignAgain_enrollsNewMembersButDoesNotDuplicateTheSource

RF-18 decision: SessionClosedAttemptSubmitter.onSessionClosed also loads CREATED attempts (findBySessionPublicIdAndTenantIdAndStatus(..., CREATED), non-deleted), leaves status CREATED, sets gradingExcluded=true and gradingExclusionReason="NOT_STARTED", saveAll; no submit event, no delete
